title: Delimit an exponential output-height obstruction on a non-reaction support family
statement: For even N and artificial S_N={(k,0):0<=k<=N} union{(N,1)}, target(N/2,1/2),epsilon=.01, mean accuracy forces top-point probability p in[.49,.51] and lower-row mean<.022N for large N. Truncated-Poisson monotonicity gives lambda1<N/4; balancing the top gives lambda2=[p/(1-p)]*N!/lambda1^N*sum_(k<=N)lambda1^k/k! >=(.49/.51)(4/e)^N. ORDINARY positive rational lambda2 needs Omega(N) bits though N has O(logN) input digits. This is NOT a fixed-R weakly reversible counterexample: no such reaction realization is provided, and uniform local activation excludes the obvious long-bottom-row/unique-distant-positive-second-coordinate realization. Generic bounded-step connectivity/finite-support entropy bounds alone cannot supply the requested actual-class inverse-height theorem.
